done: Gorigan's desk is bare.

intro: Nascour: So you are the one who has undone every plan of ours. I am Nascour, Cipher's director.

player_won: Nascour: Defeated... Forgive me, Master. I have failed you.

Es Cade: Nascour, you fool. Must I do everything myself?
He tears away the kindly mayor's face. Beneath it: Evice, the head of Cipher!
Evice: I built Realgam Tower. I built Cipher. And I will have Orre. Come, then!
player_won: Evice: Impossible... My Cipher... my tower...
Rui: You did it! Cipher's finished - and every Shadow Pokemon can be saved now!
player_lost: Evice: Cipher cannot be beaten! Leave my tower!

Old man: My, my. A young trainer, all the way out here. You wouldn't be one of those Cipher folk, would you?
You shake your head. No.
Old man: ...Then you're the one they warned us about!
The old man tears off his disguise. A Cipher Peon!

player_won: Cipher Peon Baila: Some disguise... The Admins will stop you!

done: A torn-off fake beard lies in the sand.

lines: Venus: You again, darling? Realgam is my stage now. Let's make this pretty!

player_won: Dakim: Grrr... I'm done. The Green Key. Take it!
You got the Green Key!

lines: Dakim: I've waited for this! No mountain between us now. Smash!

player_won: Dakim: Grrr... I'm done. The Green Key. Take it!
You got the Green Key!

done: You got the Green Key!

lines: A Cipher healing machine. Your Pokemon are fully healed!
Cipher Peon Verde: The Mystery Troop never gives up! Green means go!

player_won: Cipher Peon Verde: Stopped again...

lines: Cipher Peon Verde: The Mystery Troop never gives up! Green means go!

player_won: Cipher Peon Verde: Stopped again...

done: Cipher Peon Verde: Stopped again...

player_won: Cipher Peon Rosso: Not again...

lines: Cipher Peon Rosso: Red means danger - for you!

player_won: Cipher Peon Rosso: Not again...

done: Cipher Peon Rosso: Not again...

player_won: Cipher Peon Bluno: Feeling blue...

lines: Cipher Peon Bluno: Blue is the colour of victory! Or... it was.

player_won: Cipher Peon Bluno: Feeling blue...

done: Cipher Peon Bluno: Feeling blue...

lines: A man in a black suit and dark glasses leans over. 'Psst. Don't blow my cover.'
Silva: It's me, Silva, from The Under. I snuck in to find out who's really running Cipher.
Silva: The lifts at the end of the hall... only the one on the right works. Watch yourself.

done: Silva: (I'm not here.)

lines: The lift's doors won't open.
This lift isn't working either.
The lift's doors slide open... and out steps a familiar face!
Gonzap: Well, if it isn't my old snagger. Evice pays better than you'd think, kid. Nothing personal!

player_won: Gonzap: Bah! You always did have a knack for it. The roof's that way. Go on.

lines: The lift's doors slide open... and out steps a familiar face!

player_won: Gonzap: Bah! You always did have a knack for it. The roof's that way. Go on.

done: The lift hums, empty now.

The lift to the roof won't come. Something's blocking it below.
Navigator: You came all this way on a Kyogre robot? Ha! Here, take this. Battle CD 31.

done: Navigator: The storm never lets up round this island.

lines: Tucked among the rocks below the fortress: a PP Max!
A Cipher healing machine. Your Pokemon are fully healed!
A box with a Max Elixir.

3 Hyper Potions.

Behind the crate: 2 White Herbs.

A PP Up.
An Elixir.

Lovrina: YOU! Greevil scolded me because of you, {player_name}. But it doesn't matter now - XD001 is complete!
Lovrina: Nothing can purify it. Nothing! Let me show you what my darlings can do!

player_won: Lovrina: Ugh! Go on, then. Go and see XD001 for yourself. You'll be sorry.

Snattle steps out of the left lift, purple in the face.
Snattle: You! You humiliated me on live television! Greevil promised me all of Orre - and I'll start by beating you!

player_won: Snattle: Not again... There goes my governorship.

lines: Ardos: I am Ardos, Grand Master Greevil's guard. The Dome is closed to you.

player_won: Ardos: ...Go in, then. You'll find Father has prepared for you.

lines: Gorigan stomps out of the lift. 'You wrecked my Key Lair! Round two!'

player_won: Gorigan: Again?! This isn't fair! I'm getting out of here!
Gorigan runs off down the lift.

lines: A Cipher healing machine. Your Pokemon are fully healed!
A Max Revive by the wall.
The big screen shows a storm swirling round the island. A word flashes on it: XD001.

Eldes: Father sent me to stop you. I am Eldes. Forgive me - I must.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Orre
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You rode into the Outskirt Stand at dawn. A rider is sitting at the far end of the diner. Talk to him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble in Phenac
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Willie said to sharpen your skills in Phenac City. Ride there. Those men with the sack were headed the same way...

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mayor of Phenac
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Rui saw Pokémon with a dark aura. Take her to Mayor Es Cade. His house is on the west side of town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Poké Balls
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Your Snag Machine can catch Shadow Pokémon, but you have no Poké Balls. Ask the bartender at the Outskirt Stand.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at the Mayor's
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Something's wrong at the Mayor's house in Phenac City! Hurry back.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Phenac's Guards
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Three men in strange outfits are guarding Phenac's ways out, each with a Shadow Pokémon. Beat one and snag its Pokémon!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite Town
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pyrite is a rough town. Shadow Pokémon are being handed out in its duel square! Then find Rogue Cail: a thug by the Colosseum knows where he is.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Missing Gear
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Silva took the Gear from Duking's windmill, and the Colosseum has no power. He may have hidden it at the Construction Lot. Ride there from Pyrite's bike.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The windmill turns again and the Colosseum has power. Win its four rounds, then face the Gym Leader, Duking, for the Pyrite Badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher's Hideout
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Miror B.'s gang took Duking's Plusle! Their hideout is the Pyrite Building, by the bridge. Get to the roof, then past the guard to Pyrite Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Miror B. in Pyrite Cave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Admin Miror B. is hiding in Pyrite Cave with Shadow Pokémon. Dance your way past him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Agate Village
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Fateen saw trouble coming to Agate Village, where Rui's grandparents live. Ride north and visit the elder's house.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Relic Cave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's men pushed into the Relic Cave, and Rui's grandfather Eagun went after them. Follow him in!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Agate Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Agate Village has a Gym: Blaine and Erika battle side by side. Cross its hall of light, then win the Agate Badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Dakim at Mt. Battle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Admin Dakim is attacking Mt. Battle, next to Agate Village. Stop him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Vander's Thanks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Dakim fled Mt. Battle. Talk to Area Leader Vander, the trainer Dakim beat, at the top of Area 1.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Elevator Key
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Duking caught two of Miror B.'s peons; they're in the cells at Pyrite's sheriff's office. Take the Jail Key from the desk and see what they're carrying.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into The Under
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Elevator Key works the Pyrite Building's giant lift down to The Under, a town Venus runs from her TV studio. Find the kids fighting her: the Kids Grid.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Silva in a Cage
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Under's Cipher peons locked Silva up as a spy. Deal with his two guards and talk to him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Venus's Studio
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the F-Disk and the R-Disk, the floating platform reaches Venus's TV studio. Beat Cipher Admin Venus!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: After Venus
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Venus ran down the studio's back stairs to the old subway. Follow her, and find the key to the Shadow Pokemon Lab's main gate.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Under Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Under has its own Colosseum. Win its tournament, and the way to Cipher's lab opens.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ein's Shadow Pokémon Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher makes Shadow Pokémon in a secret lab. Find Cipher Admin Ein and stop the machines!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ein's Data ROM
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ein dropped a Data ROM in his lab. Take it to Nett in The Under - the Kids Grid can crack it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Snagem Ruins
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Snagem's old hideout in the desert is a Gym now. Its Leader, Pryce, waits in the cold halls. Win the Snagem Badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at the HQ Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane's Pokemon HQ Lab, near Gateon Port, works on purifying Shadow Pokemon. Pay it a visit.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Machine Part
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took Professor Krane. Lily needs a Machine Part for the Purify Chamber: ask Perr at Gateon Port's Parts Shop. His dad Makan is at Kaminko's House.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lovrina's Cipher Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Datan traced Cipher's car to the old Shadow Pokemon Lab, reopened as the Cipher Lab. Rescue Professor Krane and beat Cipher Admin Lovrina!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Data for Nett
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane is home. Take his research data to Nett at the ONBS building in Pyrite Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Duking's Poke Spots
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Duking has found Poke Spots, where wild Pokemon appear. Meet him at the Rock Poke Spot off the Desert Trail, then the Oasis and the Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The ONBS Building
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took over Orre's TV station in Pyrite Town! Battle Commander Exol and get it back.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The S.S. Libra
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took the S.S. Libra, and a little girl's Bonsly was aboard. The ship lies in the deep sand: Gateon's Parts Shop may know how to cross it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher's Phenac
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher is wearing Phenac's faces. Get the mayor's secretary some music, unmask the fake Justys, clear the Pre Gym, then face Cipher Admin Snattle at Phenac Stadium.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Free Phenac's People
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Snattle dropped the Pre Gym's Elevator Key. Free the townsfolk Cipher locked in its basement.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Phenac Stadium
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Phenac Stadium's tournament is open to snaggers: four rounds, then the Gym Leader, Misty. Win the Phenac Badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Runaway at the Outskirt Stand
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Someone who fled Cipher is waiting at the Outskirt Stand. Miror B. may be about, too.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Snagem Hideout
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Snagem's hideout is out in the desert. Their boss, Gonzap, has Shadow Pokémon too. Take him on!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Orre Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The biggest tournament in Orre! Beat three challengers, then Pre Gym Leader Justy in the final, to be crowned its champion.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher Key Lair
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher has a base in Gateon Port, the Key Lair. Get past the thug at its door.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The System Lever
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Through the maze and the crate rooms: take the System Lever from its table, then put it in the Control Room's panel.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher Admin Gorigan
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The power's up. Beat Smarton, then climb to Gorigan's hall and beat him to learn where Cipher's leader is.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Realgam Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's leader is behind Realgam Tower. Go in by the lobby's left door, cross the tower yard, and take the four coloured keys from Cipher's Admins in the Dome Halls.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Inside the Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The four keys open the giant door. Get through the Tower Halls to the lifts at the far end.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher's Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ride the lift to the roof. Four matches, then Nascour, then Cipher's leader - and no healing in between. Stock up first!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Professor Krane's Eevee
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane works at the Pokémon HQ Lab in Gateon Port. Pay him a visit!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ein's Data ROM
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ein left a Data ROM on his desk. Take it to Nett at the Kids Grid in The Under.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Battle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: After the title, Vander waits at the very top of Mt. Battle, past Battlus in Area 10. Climb up and face him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Battle's 100
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mt. Battle, near Agate Village: ten areas, ten trainers in each. Climb them all and beat Mt. Battle Master Battlus! Rest at the top of each area to start from the next one.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wishing Star
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's files mention a wishing star near Agate's Relic Stone. Look in the Relic Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ho-Oh's Blessing
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Purify every Shadow Pokémon at the Relic Stone. Then a rainbow Pokémon may appear in the Relic Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Gale of Darkness
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher is back under Grand Master Greevil, on Citadark Isle. Professor Krane has something for you first - visit the HQ Lab, then take the Robo Kyogre from Gateon Port.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Citadark Isle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Climb Greevil's island: the fortress, the volcano's platforms, the hook hall, the Dome. XD001 waits at the top.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Eagun's Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Eagun wants a word with you outside the Pokemon HQ Lab.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orre Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Seven rounds of four battles at the Orre Colosseum, healed between battles. Each round's winner gets a TM.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: XD001's Heart
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: XD001's heart is shut tight. Fill all nine sets of the HQ Lab's Purify Chamber at Max Tempo - four in each ring, each strong against the next - then put XD001 in.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Silent Pokemon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beluh e-mailed: some of Agate Village's Pokemon have gone silent. Go and see her.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Rumour in Pyrite
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Nett has heard something about Cail and a Shadow Pokemon. A kid in Pyrite saw it - he's hiding behind a bookcase.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Snagem Raid
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Snagem is back in its desert hideout, with Shadow Pokemon you missed. Nett also mentioned Gurks, on the Junk Shop's balcony in The Under. Gonzap has something you'll want.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Deep Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Slot the D-Disk into The Under's floating platform. Five rounds wait at the bottom, and the Deep King after them.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Poke Snacks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Put Poke Snacks on a Poke Spot's tray, then go somewhere else. Your P*DA's Spot Monitor beeps when something comes to eat - fast beeps mean a rare one. No snacks, no wild Pokemon.

orre_newgame_intro: Far from the green regions lies Orre, a dry land of sand, rock and wind.
Hardly any wild Pokémon live in its grass. Trainers here battle in big stadiums called Colosseums.
But lately, something is wrong. Some Pokémon have had their hearts shut tight. They attack anyone, even people.
People call them Shadow Pokémon. A secret group called Cipher is making them.
Your motorbike rumbles to a stop at Outskirt Stand, an old train turned into a diner at the edge of the desert.
orre_partners_intro: Two Pokémon hop down from the sidecar: Espeon and Umbreon.
They grew up together as Eevee, and they have never been apart.
Which one will lead the way beside you?
orre_partners_join: {other} doesn't want to be left behind! It bounds after {lead} and joins your team too.
With {lead} and {other} at your side, your journey through Orre begins!
